new_value: {"notes":"2026-11-02 evidence (mimid-1wgh.46.2): Phoenix's mimi-content (main 31487f9 and PR #20 6378938, the crate Air uses) encodes every float as f64, not shortest form; mimid refuses such content with NotShortestForm (crates/mimi-content/tests/phoenix_fixtures.rs, fixture phoenix/float.cbor). That is a Phoenix sender bug against -08/-09/-10 §6.1 (bead mimid-1wgh.46.5), but -10 §6.1 says receivers are not expected to strictly enforce encoding size, so strict decoding makes mimid refuse content from a production implementation that a lenient receiver accepts. Phoenix orders map keys and extension names per RFC 8949 §4.2.1 (no unsorted-key evidence found)."}
